coverage: Whole page once for layout; half a once from upper-left reference through the overlapping replacement-ii limits line; half b once from that overlap through the final paragraph and lower-left archive 22. Read every body line in i, bis, i ter, both ii states, iii, iv and the concluding paragraph; checked all interline/marginal additions, every deletion, both left crosses, the empty reference slot, all mathematical letters/indices/marks, both right-edge line continuations and all margins. Seventeen unique tight crops were each emitted and inspected once. No part remains unviewed. No mathematical proof checking occurred.

changes.evidence: Crop 04 shows a pen grouping/insertion line beginning left of typed C' and attached after catégorie, plus a second line from typed de C (IV 7.5 to the end of Karoubi. The apparent left parenthesis and mark after Karoubi belong to those lines. Only b)) at the reference end is handwritten text. No independent trailing comma as in C or enclosing pair/final stop as in H is visible. The two closing pen parentheses are retained even though the larger opening parenthesis is not a text character.
Half a shows one ordinary typewriter U and a distinct short underline below it, with no duplicated U contour.
Half a shows a blank after the opening parenthesis before bis; there is no i stroke or dot.

changes.locus: Condition bis, machine cancellation commute aux
changes.reading: qui \deleted{commute aux} est exact à gauche.
changes.evidence: Half a and crop 05 show the word bodies of commute aux under regular x cancellations. H explicitly declares that machine cancellations are not recorded.
Crop 06 shows a low comma. The light stroke above it is part of the surrounding drawn cancellation boundary, not a second typed punctuation dot.

changes.locus: Cancelled condition (ii), et munissant / il existe sur; C002
changes.evidence: Crop 07 exposes e/t, the m/u/n run, the i position, two s contours, a/n and terminal t beneath the x cancellations. The replacement il existe sur is separately typed above. H records the replacement and describes its interline placement, but omits the cancelled wording under its stated scope.

Crop 07 shows the first d ascender and the cancelled five-cell run, with the replacement une above. The apostrophe and middle letters remain obscured by x strokes; C's doubtful d'une is retained. H omits the earlier state under its declared policy.
Half a shows clean space between X_i and X and between the lowered i and I. The diagonal crossing the first X is a paragraph cancellation stroke; no arrow or membership glyph occupies either blank.
changes.mathematical_consequence: Leaves the relations in this cancelled formula unspecified, as in the source.

changes.locus: Replacement condition (ii), initial Dans C' cancellation
changes.evidence: Half a and crop 08 show ordinary typed Dans C' under x cancellation. H omits it consistently with its announced treatment of machine biffures.

changes.locus: Replacement condition (ii), short marks above and below l in Il
changes.evidence: Crop 08 shows the ordinary I and l together with two separate short strokes: the upper horizontal turns up at its right end; the lower horizontal turns down at its right end. Their positions and shapes are reproduced, without assigning them an earlier character or a mathematical meaning.

Crop 09 shows the n hump and two baseline feet, together with a separate raised dot and a descending hooked j contour in the same slot. Both strike orders remain possible; no grammatical choice determines the order.
Half a and the overlapping top of half b show a clear separate horizontal underline below finie. H's normalem emph is an italic state.

Both halves show projectives cancelled by typed x characters, with inductives typed in the line above it. H gives the resulting text while suppressing the earlier machine cancellation under its announced policy.

changes.locus: Replacement condition (ii), cancelled est after canonical functor; C004
changes.evidence: Crop 10 shows a cancelled three-cell word, with a rounded first body and a terminal t ascender/crossbar. The central letter is heavily covered by x strokes, so est remains a tentative reading. H omits it within its declared scope.

changes.locus: Condition (iii), cancelled character at first line end
changes.evidence: Crop 11 shows an additional blackened character after représentab and before the line-end hyphen. Its tall upright/foot support l; a rounded middle and bar also allow e beneath the cancellation. The next source line begins les. The line-break hyphen is joined, but the cancelled character is retained. H's omission falls under its stated treatment of machine cancellations.

changes.locus: Condition (iii), cancelled accented a after représentables; C005
changes.evidence: Crop 12 shows a cancelled a-like body and a raised angled mark with a rising left limb and a shorter rightward/downward part. A circumflex is visible as a candidate; cancellation obscures whether the latter part belongs to the accent, so grave à remains possible. No grammatical normalization is made. H omits the cancelled glyph under its stated policy.
Whole and half b show the cross in the left margin at the I 8.8 f) row. H's accompanying note expressly specifies the left margin; C's default margin macro would put it on the right.

Crop 13 shows a single left upright and one set of the three E bars. The small pale right-edge blur is not a second separately struck E contour. Crops 14–16 separately confirm ordinary E at the three other occurrences.
Whole and half b place this second cross to the left of pleine E_PF and the empty parenthesis. H's note gives the same left placement; C's unqualified margin command does not.

Crop 15 shows three distinct pen strokes: an upper wave, a second angular wave below it, and a lower horizontal bar. It is not the one-wave/one-bar simeq glyph. C', E, P and F were separately checked as ordinary typewriter letters.
changes.mathematical_consequence: Preserves the drawn three-stroke relation without changing it to a conventional two-stroke isomorphism sign.

changes.evidence: Half b shows la topologie beneath regular typed x cancellations after De plus,. H suppresses it under the stated machine-biffure policy.

notes.text: The sheet sets an Exercice 2 and asks for equivalence of the listed conditions concerning Ind(C), topologies, the canonical functor, and E_PF. There is an earlier fully cancelled version of (ii), including internal cancelled words and interline replacements. This is a description of the source task, not an assertion that the equivalence has been verified.
notes.basis: Observation: opening and conditions (i), ( bis), (i ter), both (ii) states, (iii), (iv).

notes.text: The source leaves the i position blank in ( bis), the two relation positions blank in the cancelled family formula, an unmatched ST) in (iii), and an empty parenthesis after E_PF in (iv). All remain as observed; no missing mathematical notation or reference has been reconstructed.
notes.basis: Direct ink observations in half a and half b; crop 14 confirms the empty iv reference.

notes.text: The final paragraph says that the topology in (i ter) is necessarily the one described in (ii), that the E of (iv) is necessarily equivalent to Ind(C), and gives a perfectness condition involving representability of finite projective limits in C'. These statements were transcribed only. The inserted dans and cancelled est are preserved.
notes.basis: Observation: final five-line paragraph, with crop 17 for the last correction; no proof check.

notes.text: SGA 4 VI 2 and Exercice 2 are reference/exercise numbers. No date or authorial page number is visible. The pencil 22 at the lower-left corner is recorded only as the archive-sheet comment, not as mspage.
notes.basis: Observation: upper-left reference, opening title, all margins and lower-left corner.

notes.text: H explicitly says it does not record machine-made biffures and that words typed in the interline are given without marks. Corresponding omissions are recorded as declared scope differences. Routine H notes/add/struck do not count as H uncertainty marks. The source's visible underlines nevertheless differ from H's normalem emph.
notes.basis: H's introductory editorial note; direct comparison with source corrections and underlines.

notes.text: The l in replacement ii Il has two separate corner-ended strokes. Their shapes are reproduced in TikZ without naming an earlier character or explaining their function. In contrast, the crowded s in the live bis est does not yield an independently legible second character or securely offset complete s; plain s is retained.
notes.basis: Observation: crops 08 and 05 respectively. No mathematical inference or proof check.
